finding: Supabase CLI renders an absent remote migration version as a backtick-wrapped blank cell. Trimming before removing backticks leaves one space and falsely marks the remote side as present.
rule: Normalize presentation delimiters first and trim the normalized value before migration identity comparison.
prevention: trim each parsed cell after surrounding backtick removal
apply identical normalization before and after supported migration repair
regression-test the exact blank remote-cell representation
remain fail-closed on real remote-only or identity drift
evidence: trusted-main run 37425004020 attempt 4 reached provider readback and showed the four allowlisted local versions with blank remote cells
the current parser raised REMOTE_ONLY_OR_IDENTITY_DRIFT before provider mutation because the normalized remote value remained a single space
root_cause: The parser trimmed each CLI table cell before removing surrounding backticks. For an absent remote version rendered as backtick-space-backtick, backtick removal exposed a single space that was never trimmed again, so the fail-closed remote-drift guard interpreted the remote side as present.
